framing: Q-Lead 2026-05-04 20:15: 30% cash residual의 답 = Cross-Asset Time-Series Momentum (TSMOM) on KR ETF Universe. 학술 anchor: Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen (2012 JFE) + Asness-Moskowitz-Pedersen (2013 JFE). 정의상 직교 (cross-section vs time-series) + 위기 hedge 자연 내장 (long-only TSMOM).
rationale: Q-Lead 2026-05-04 20:00: XGBoost primary 편향 제거. Q-Lead 2026-05-04 20:15: Pure TSMOM baseline 의무 + ML 3-method 정교화 framing. ML must beat TSMOM by marginal Sharpe +0.05 OR cor improvement to justify complexity (Occam's razor).

baseline_tsmom.name: Pure TSMOM 12-1m vol-scaled long-only (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012 §3.3)
baseline_tsmom.rule: signal_i,t = trailing 12m return of ETF_i (PIT t-1, skip last month). w_i > 0 only if signal_i > 0. Vol-scaled w_i ∝ target_vol / vol_i. All-cash if no positive signals. Σw_i = 1.
references: Moskowitz, T.J., Ooi, Y.H., Pedersen, L.H. (2012). Time series momentum. JFE 104(2), 228-250.
Asness, C.S., Moskowitz, T.J., Pedersen, L.H. (2013). Value and momentum everywhere. JFE 68(3), 929-985.
Hurst, B., Ooi, Y.H., Pedersen, L.H. (2017). A century of evidence on trend-following investing. JPM 44(1), 15-29.

HMM.name: HMM regime-conditional ensemble (Hamilton 1989, Ang-Bekaert 2002)
HMM.rationale: STR_1715 M4 (trend) + AR (concentration) regime conditional 구조와 자연 결합. 2-state HMM on KOSPI 월간 ret → state-conditional Sharpe-weighted softmax allocation

GP.name: Gaussian Process Bayesian per-ETF (kernlab gausspr)
GP.rationale: small data n=312 월간 obs에서 uncertainty quantification 필수. GP posterior mean/sd → Bayesian Sharpe (mean/sd) → softmax

RL.name: Direct Policy Gradient with custom cor-penalty reward (REINFORCE-lite)
RL.rationale: Cross-asset rotation = policy learning본질. cor penalty가 reward에 자연 통합. Sharpe 직접 최대화 + cor 직접 최소화

hyperparameters.architecture: linear softmax policy theta = K x (nF+1)

strengths: direct policy + cor penalty in objective

XGBoost.rationale: tabular per-ETF prediction baseline (도훈 명시 primary 아님 — 단지 비교용)

ensemble_decision.rationale: 3 methods address complementary aspects: HMM (regime), GP (uncertainty), RL (direct policy + cor). Equal weighting avoids hyper-meta-search on weighting scheme (which itself would inflate DSR multiple-testing penalty).
ensemble_decision.fallback: If primary cor > 0.30: use HMM only (lowest cor expected from regime structure)

pit_compliance: All features lagged t-1; no full-sample stats; walk-forward expanding window only

ml_marginal_value_check.decision: Occam favors pure TSMOM (ML marginal value not proven)
